mentions.name: CurveFit
mentions.description: This web app is a weightlifting SPA that explores the pareto frontier of a lifter's strength across weight and rep count, and gathers data to understand how fatigue works. It is rep-based, with bar speed measurement in development (currently by strapping a phone to the wrist, with plans for an iOS app supporting the Apple Watch).
mentions.source_excerpt: https://curvefit.app - a weightlifting SPA that explores the pareto frontier of your strength (weight vs rep count). My specific interest is gathering data to understand how fatigue works. It's rep-based, but I'm working on adding bar speed measurement (right now by strapping my phone to my wrist, but I'll probably make an iOS app and support the Apple Watch)
mentions.author: jerkstate
